title: TRAFFIC PATROL: MMDA to suspend number coding on Nov. 16-18
summary: The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said Wednesday it would suspend the number coding scheme from Nov. 16 to 18 in line with the special non-working holiday for the ASEAN Summit.
